service.description: Publish an organization's Sales defaults from now or later (design §9 SalesDefaults): the row in effect then is ended where the new one starts, which keeps its values for each field not given; the acceptance thresholds, when given, replace the earlier ones (one per currency). previewOnly Y answers the changes and writes nothing. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE for an organization of the caller's sales scope (PERMISSION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED); refuses no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), nothing changed (NO_CHANGE), a start before now or before the row it replaces (DATE_INVALID), a missing or stale revision of the row it replaces (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), a team of another organization (TEAM_INVALID), an unknown template (TEMPLATE_INVALID), a day count that is not a positive whole number (VALUE_INVALID) and a threshold without its currency or twice in one (CURRENCY_INVALID, THRESHOLD_DUPLICATE).

parameter.name: revision
parameter.description: The revision of the defaults read (get#SalesPolicy's policy.revision)

parameter.name: rfqAcknowledge
parameter.description: Y: a request for quote made from mail is acknowledged to its sender (Sales P20 review)

parameter.name: acceptanceThresholds
parameter.description: Each a map: currencyUomId, thresholdAmount (empty to remove it)

service.description: An organization's Sales defaults in effect (each field, the thresholds, who published them and why), the scheduled and the earlier versions, and the effective commercial revision flag (X2, F9) with the organization whose preference sets it. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE for an organization of the caller's sales scope.

The seller's own PartyAcctgPreference.salesCommercialRevisionOnly (X2; impl-sales §4, F9: a quote is issued only where it is on), audit-logged with its reason. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE for an organization of the caller's sales scope; refuses no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and an organization that takes its preference from a parent (PREFERENCE_INHERITED).

An approval rule of an organization (design §9 ApprovalRules): a new rule from now or later, the next version of a rule (salesApprovalPolicyId; the rule ends where the next starts) or, with endPolicy Y, the rule ended. A rule has a purpose (SapQuote: a quote's exception, decided before it is proposed; SapOrder: a sales order's approval) and a bounded type: SarAmount (thresholdAmount and currencyUomId), SarDiscount (discountPercent, above 0 and at most 100), SarPriceFloor (floorMarginPercent over the product's cost) or SarFreeLine; the approvers' group (approverUserGroupId, holding SALES_APPROVE) and self-approval (selfApprovalAllowed Y). Needs SALES_CONFIGURE for an organization of the caller's sales scope; refuses no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), an unknown purpose or type (PURPOSE_INVALID, RULE_INVALID), a type's missing or invalid input (THRESHOLD_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID, PERCENT_REQUIRED, PERCENT_INVALID, VALUE_INVALID), a group that holds no SALES_APPROVE (APPROVER_INVALID), dates out of order (DATE_INVALID), a missing or stale revision of the rule changed (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED) and an ended rule (RULE_ENDED); another organization's rule answers as missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

An organization's approval rules (in effect and scheduled; the ended ones too with includeEnded Y), each with its purpose, type, inputs as text, approvers and dates, and whether the organization has a quote rule (configured: without one a manual price needs an approver other than its author). For a Sales reader of the organization.

The approvals a quote needs at its current revision (design §9 ApprovalPreview): each rule it meets with its inputs (the lines and amounts it names; a price floor's cost is checked here and never answered), the approver it needs, its state (needs approval, waiting, approved, refused, with who decided and why) and whether the caller may decide it or ask for it. For a quote the caller sees (SalesAccess.js quoteOf: the rep's, the team's, the organization's for SALES_TEAM_VIEW, and one that asked for approval for a holder of SALES_APPROVE in its organization); another answers as missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Ask the approvers of a draft quote's open rules at its revision (an OrderDecision of result SdrRequested for each rule not asked for or refused, a rule set since an earlier request among them; one SalesQuoteApproval notice, in place of the earlier one, to the holders of SALES_APPROVE of the organization who may decide a rule still waiting, titled with the quote and the customer and no amount, naming those rules as its ruleKeys). Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a quote the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), one that needs no approval or is approved (APPROVAL_NOT_NEEDED) and one whose every open rule is asked for already (APPROVAL_REQUESTED).

Approve or refuse a quote's rules at the revision read (design §5 the approval binding): one rule (salesApprovalPolicyId, "default" for the manual-price rule of an organization with no quote rule), the open ones of a list (salesApprovalPolicyIds, a notice's rules) or every open rule, each an OrderDecision bound to the revision, the rule and the time, with the reason (required to refuse); every rule chosen must be the caller's to decide, else none is. Needs SALES_APPROVE (PERMISSION_DENIED) in the quote's organization; refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT) or has expired (QUOTE_EXPIRED), a missing or stale revision naming the current one (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), a rule the quote no longer meets (APPROVAL_NOT_NEEDED), its author (its owner, who asked for the approval or entered the lines the rule names) unless the rule allows it (SELF_APPROVAL), one outside the rule's group (APPROVER_INVALID) and an unknown decision (DECISION_INVALID). The same operation key answers the first result.

parameter.name: salesApprovalPolicyIds
parameter.description: The rules to decide (their ids, "default" for the manual-price rule): those of the notice decided (its ruleKeys), so a rule set after it was sent is not

service.description: The approve service of the SalesQuoteApproval topic, which the framework's decide#NotificationMessage calls as the user: decide#Quote at the revision in the message (sourceRevision) of the rules it asked for (ruleKeys), so a quote changed since is refused naming its current revision, a message with none is refused (REVISION_REQUIRED), a rule set after it was sent is not decided, and an approver who may not decide each of them decides none (the framework then leaves the notice to the others); another record or a message naming no rule is SOURCE_INVALID.
The refuse service of the SalesQuoteApproval topic, with the reason: decide#Quote's refusal at the message's revision; refuses as approve#QuoteMessage does.

The SECA on increment#OrderRevision (service/SalesApproval.secas.xml): a commercial change of a quote supersedes the decisions of its earlier revisions (invalidatedDate) and reads their approval notices. Any other order returns at once.

Sales' pre-approval warnings for the SECA on check#OrderPreApprove (impl-sales §4 Nov 11, F60): for each sales part of a seller with a Sales rule in effect, the quote rules an accepted quote meets without a current approval and the order rules the order meets, each naming the rule's kind and id and never an amount. None for an organization with no rule or an order that meets none.
